Select IC50 activities against human Pim-1 kinase. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, then to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join docs on activities.doc_id. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target name 'Pim-1 kinase' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate.
